summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # **Petition No. 9/RP/2019 in Petition No. 2/SM/2019** **Coram:** # **Shri P.K. Pujari, Chairperson Shri I. S. Jha, Member** # **Date of Order: 6** **th** **August, 2021** # **In the matter of** Application under Section 94(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 103 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999, and principles of order 47 of CPC seeking review of order dated 31.1.2019 in Petition No. 2/SM/20219. # **And** # **In the matter of** Coastal Gujarat Power Limited, Corporate Centre, 36, Sant Tukaram Road, Carnac Bunder, Mumbai-400 009 ... ** Review Petitioner ** # **Vs** Power System Operation Corporation Limited, B-9, Ist Floor, Qutab Institutional Area, Katwaria Sarai, New Delhi-110 016 **...Respondent** # ** ORDER ** The Review Petitioner, Coastal Gujarat Power Limited, has filed the present Petition for review of the order dated 31.1.2019 in Petition No. 2/SM/20219 under Section 94(1)(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 103 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999 with the following prayers: _ “ (a) Review the order dated 31.1.2019 passed by the Commission in Petition No. 02/SM/2019 (Suo-Moto) and exempt the Applicant from the SCED Pilot project and also from future participation in SCED after completion of the SCED Pilot project; and _ Order in 9/RP/2019 Page 1 _ (b) In the alternative, and without prejudice, compensate the Applicant for aggregate financial impact for the period from 1.4.2019 till such date the SCED was implemented vis-à-vis the Applicant.” _ 2. The learned counsel for the Review Petitioner, vide his letter dated 4.8.2021, has sought permission to withdraw the instant Review Petition with immediate effect. Considering the request, the Petitioner is permitted to withdraw the Review Petition No. 9/RP/2019. 3. Accordingly, the Review Petition No. 9/RP/2019 is disposed of as withdrawn. # **Sd/-** **Sd/sd/(I.S. Jha) (P.K. Pujari) Chairperson** Order in 9/RP/2019 Page 2 CERC Website S.No. 399/2021
